rv.q: Michelle portrays Simone with a fiery commitment to the musician’s mood swings, prickliness and arch stylings.
Little Girl Blue is a grand showcase for Laiona Michelle and a powerful affirmation of Nina Simone.
Whatever its structural oddities, Little Girl Blue etches an indelible portrait of a star who dealt from her own deck, damning the consequences -- and Michelle knows how to put on a show.
However, Little Girl Blue was just too little and too blue.
Michelle largely captures the essence of an exceedingly complex woman, avoiding outright copy-catting in this dazzling stage performance.

cn.t: Laiona Michelle's biographical musical earns praise for her powerhouse performance channeling Nina Simone, though critics split on whether the show adequately captures the icon's complexity beyond a well-executed concert tribute.
